title: The Open Study Without Walls

features.name: books-unfurling
features.desc-on-touch: Pages that did not know they were pages, now reading themselves in open air. The words rearrange in the wind, finding new meanings the ceiling used to hide.

features.name: light-made-visible
features.desc-on-touch: An angle of sun rendered as architecture. The light is now something you can touch. It carries the text: time of day, season, year. The whole book was always light.

features.name: the-reading-expands
features.desc-on-touch: A doorway that opens not to another room but to the landscape beyond. You read the field like a page. The field reads you. Neither has walls anymore.

features.name: the-knowledge-rising
features.desc-on-touch: Words float upward like motes, becoming weather. The study taught them how to climb. They are not lost. They are everywhere.

features.name: the-mirror-dissolving
features.desc-on-touch: A surface that reflected the page. Now it reflects the sky. The study learned that the reflection was always the reading—the angle of light that shows you what you look at.

inscription: the study opened like a book and learned that reading was always about how light breaks through

reverie.title: REVERIE — the study opening onto field at dusk
narr: You sit where the wall used to be.
She holds a book open to the light.
The page glows. The field beyond glows.
There is no difference. Reading was
what was always in front of you.

file.name: Study_Ceiling_Collapse_Field_Notes_Autumn.txt
file.note: What happened when the study's roof opened. Katita documented how the books continued reading themselves in weather, how the field became legible.

exits.label: the path back to the enclosed study where mirrors still reflect
upward into the sky where reading continues without ground
across the field to where other studies are learning to open
into the dusk where the world reads back to itself
